meta.title: APETIT by WebbingHUB — Digital hospitality platform
meta.description: APETIT turns every table into a smooth guest experience: QR ordering, reservations and live updates for restaurants, cafés and hotels — by WebbingHUB.
meta.ogAlt: APETIT by WebbingHUB — the digital hospitality platform
meta.tagline: The digital platform for modern hospitality

hero.title: The digital heartbeat of modern hospitality.
hero.subtitle: APETIT turns every table into a smooth guest experience. Ordering, reservations, and reviews run through one platform, built and maintained for restaurants, cafés, and hotels.
hero.ctaPrimary: Talk to us about your venue
hero.about: APETIT is a digital platform for restaurants, cafés and hotels. Guests scan a QR code at the table to read the menu, order, book and leave reviews from their own phone, with no app to download. Your staff run it all from one dashboard. We design, build and maintain the system, so you can focus on welcoming people.

marquee.label: Built for every kind of table

platform.title: Everything your venue needs, woven into one experience.
platform.intro: We don't hand you a tool and walk away. APETIT is a full service. We design it, set it up, and look after it, so you run the hospitality and we run the tech.

services.title: QR-powered ordering
services.body: Guests scan, read the menu in their own language, and order from the table. No app. No waiting.

services.title: Reservations that fill seats
services.body: We handle bookings, confirmations and reminders end to end, so your floor stays full and no-shows drop.

services.title: Real-time command center
services.body: Orders, requests and reviews land on your team's screen the moment they happen. Nothing slips past.

services.title: Guest engagement
services.body: Loyalty, offers and well-timed nudges turn first visits into regulars, working in the background.

services.title: Insight, not noise
services.body: Clear signals on what your guests order and when they come, so you decide on facts, not hunches.

services.title: Done-for-you & maintained
services.body: We set it up, host it, and keep it running. If anything breaks, we fix it. You focus on hospitality.

steps.title: We set you up
steps.body: Your menu, your tables, your brand. We build it, set up the domain, and print the QR codes, ready to place.

steps.title: Guests experience it
steps.body: A scan opens an on-brand flow: read the menu, order, reserve and review, all from the phone in their hand.

steps.title: You stay in control
steps.body: Watch it all from one calm dashboard while we keep the engine running behind the scenes.

why.title: Technology that gives you back to your guests.
why.intro: The best hospitality tech is the kind nobody notices. Ours stays out of the way so your team can do what they do best.

props.title: Keep what's yours
props.body: No middleman skims your margins. No third party stands between you and your guests. The relationship and the data stay yours.

props.title: Zero friction for guests
props.body: Nothing to download, nothing to learn. One scan and they're ordering. The lower the barrier, the more they spend.

props.title: One team behind it all
props.body: Strategy, design, build and upkeep from one agency. One point of contact. No finger-pointing, no surprises.

a.title: Pull up a chair.
a.body: A scan opens the table. The seat slides out. The welcome starts before anyone says a word.

b.title: You just host.
b.body: Orders, bookings, the lights, the small details. APETIT runs in the background so every guest feels expected.

contact.title: Ready to bring your venue to life?
contact.body: We don't pitch from a slide deck. We visit your venue, sit with your team, and listen to the people who work the floor. Then we show you how APETIT fits.

reach.heading: How would you like to reach us?

footer.blurb: Digital tools for restaurants, cafés & hotels. We design, build and maintain them so you can focus on hospitality.
